about.title: Containers shaped around what you actually need
about.intro: Euro Container Market started from a simple observation: the standard ISO shipping container, built for freight, is also one of the sturdiest, fastest-to-deploy, and cheapest-per-square-meter structures around — provided you know how to source it, inspect it, and sometimes rebuild it. That's the trade we've been in for over twenty years.
about.storyBody1: It began with reselling used shipping containers coming off the major Europe–Asia freight lines: units built to take years of port handling, retired by shipping lines long before the end of their useful life. We built our sourcing network around those flows, working directly with port depots in France, Belgium, and Germany.
about.storyBody2: Over time, demand shifted: our customers didn't just want storage anymore — they wanted to live, work, or host in a container. We built out a conversion workshop — insulation, wiring, openings, plumbing — to deliver turnkey office, bar, pool, and mobile-home containers, while holding every unit, new or used, to the same inspection standard before it goes live in the catalog.
about.valuesSubtitle: The part that doesn't change, whatever the container.

values.title: Systematic inspection
values.body: Every container, new or used, is inspected (structure, watertightness, flooring) before it joins the catalog — no listing goes live without this step.

values.title: Transparent pricing
values.body: The listed price includes the inspected container; delivery costs are shown before you confirm your order, never after.

values.title: Delivery across Europe
values.body: Transport arranged to France, Belgium, Germany, Spain, and Luxembourg, with an estimated lead time given at checkout.

values.title: Technical guidance
values.body: Our team advises on container choice, dimensions, and conversion options before you buy.

process.title: Choose
process.body: Browse the catalog by size (15, 20, 40 feet) or by use (storage, office, pool, bar, living space).

process.title: Configure
process.body: For converted containers, talk to our team about the finishes and options specific to your project.

process.title: Receive

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about our containers, delivery, and orders.

items.question: What's the difference between a new and a used container?
items.answer: A new container has never been used for maritime shipping. A used container has been in service but is always inspected and refurbished before sale.

items.question: Do you deliver across Europe?
items.answer: Yes, we arrange delivery to most European countries. Lead time and cost depend on the destination and are shown before you confirm your order.

items.question: Can I have a container customized (windows, insulation, electricity)?
items.answer: Yes, we offer already-converted containers (office, bar, pool, home) and can look into specific customization requests.

items.question: What are the delivery lead times?
items.answer: Lead times vary depending on the container type, availability, and destination. An accurate estimate is provided when you place your order.

items.question: Do you offer container rental?
items.answer: Get in touch with our team to discuss rental options suited to your project and its duration.

returns.title: Returns policy
returns.body: Every container is inspected before shipping. If you notice an issue on delivery, contact us within 48 hours with photos: we'll review a return, exchange, or other resolution based on the situation.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.body: Transport is arranged by us to the destination given at checkout. Delivery times and costs depend on the container type, quantity, and location, and are shown before you confirm your order.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.body: These terms govern container sales made through this site. For any question about an ongoing order or these terms, our team is available to help.
